findings.text: the new custom JVP expands the point jet to 55,504 equations versus the 22,000 bound and raises uncached H200 compile wall from 94.576 to 305.636 s (3.23 times); the two-arm suite records test_point_jet_expression_bound as one added failure, violating the source done_when's no-added-failure clause.

the byte-identity assertion compares the wrapper with _packed_analytic_moments_primal in the same head, so changing the shared primal expression moves both sides together and leaves the test green instead of proving byte identity to the base revision.

the fragment accepts 1.049720e-6 and 1.652340e-6 m direct-axis errors by invoking a 2e-6 m restatement without amending the source briefs 1e-6 m done_when; the source brief's done_when requires each carrier within 1e-6 m, so neither measured carrier satisfies the stated gate.
